stage0063_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$田中司令$$
「According to Director $$大塚$$,
　these ruins may be the Mechanical Beast Army's base」

stage0063_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「No response from sensors or anything else」

stage0063_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ミサト$$
「If it's come to this, all we can do is
　dig through the ruins ourselves」

stage0063_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Indeed.
　And our digging expert is in fine form, too」

stage0063_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ボス$$
「Is that $$あしゅら$$ jerk really out here?」

stage0063_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You're out of it.
　We don't know when a Mechanical Beast might show up」

stage0063_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ミカ$$
「Be careful!
　There's a huge energy reading from underground!」

stage0063_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$タケル$$
「So this really is their base!」

stage0063_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Welcome, $$兜甲児$$ and $c!
　Today, I'll finally settle this with you!」

stage0063_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Just so you know,
　we're always ready for that!」

stage0063_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$赤木$$
「You're the one making excuses
　and running away, if anything!」

stage0063_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Grrr!
　Such a mouthy bunch!」

stage0063_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Don't rise to their taunts, $$ブロッケン$$」

stage0063_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I know...!
　I'll give the insolent what they deserve!」

stage0063_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$隼人$$
「So the enemy's thrown every Mechanical Beast they have」

stage0063_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Seems they mean to finish this for real」

stage0063_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Just what I wanted!
　Don't slip up, everyone!」

stage0063_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here we go, $$あしゅら$$, $$ブロッケン$$!
　I'll end our fight right here!!」

stage0063_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$あしゅら$$
（No, it's about to begin...!）

stage0063_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Don't underestimate me, $c!
　I am an unbreakable man!」

stage0063_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Grrr!
　As expected, from the ones who've made me
　suffer before! You really deliver!」

stage0063_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Then, we'll use our trump card too」

stage0063_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「A trump card...
　You have something like that?」

stage0063_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Yes!
　That's part of Mycenae's legacy of terror!」

stage0063_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$さやか$$
「Something else is coming from underground!」

stage0063_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ボス$$
「Damn it!
　They still had a $$タロス像$$ left!」

stage0063_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$タケル$$
「Why is something like that underground!?」

stage0063_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
Kedora
「All civilizations but Mycenae will be erased...」

stage0063_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$甲児$$
「So Kedora is controlling that $$タロス像$$!?」

stage0063_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シモン$$
「Watch out!
　If that's riding it, this is no ordinary
　$$タロス像$$, that's for sure!」

stage0063_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「This is the legacy of terror...!
　A power of Mycenae humans can't imagine!」

stage0063_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$隼人$$
「Mycenae was using that $$インベーダー#keyword$$
　as a fighting force of their own!?」

stage0063_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Who cares about that!
　Crushing these guys comes first!」

stage0063_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Now, $$ブロッケン$$!
　Use this power, and bury them!」

stage0063_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hahahaha!
　Tremble in fear, $c!
　Now I shall deliver your punishment!」

stage0063_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it...!
　Curse you, $$あしゅら$$!」

stage0063_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nuooooh!
　Th- this can't be!!」

stage0063_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Look at the palm!
　$$ブロッケン$$'s riding it!」

stage0063_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Wh- where are you, $$あしゅら$$!?
　Did you leave me behind and flee!?」

stage0063_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Argh! Fine, then!
　I'll fight on, even alone!
　To avenge Dr. Hell!!」

stage0063_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$赤木$$
「Is he... still planning to fight?」

stage0063_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$甲児$$
「Stop it already, $$ブロッケン$$!
　It's pointless to keep going!」

stage0063_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Silence! Silence!!
　At this point, I'll drag as many of you
　to hell with me as I can!」

stage0063_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「In a moment, the self-destruct device set
　beneath these ruins will go off」

stage0063_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Don't panic, $$ブロッケン$$!
　You will hold them off here!」

stage0063_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Have you forgotten your debt to Dr. Hell!?」

stage0063_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「And you plan to run away, is that it!?」

stage0063_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Of course.
　The master I serve lies elsewhere」

stage0063_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Perish along with these crumbling ruins!」

stage0063_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「That is $$あしゅら$$'s final mercy!!」

stage0063_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, fall back!
　Get as far away as you can!!」

stage0063_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$n
「Sorry.
　We can't stay and keep you company」

stage0063_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If you don't want to die, you'd better run too!」

stage0063_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I- I won't run!
　To repay my debt to Dr. Hell,
　I'll finish you here...!」

stage0063_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$甲児$$
「Suit yourself!
　We can't afford to die in a place like this!!」

stage0063_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「W- wait! Wait, please!
　I... I am...!!」

stage0063_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Uooooooooohh!!
　Long live Dr. Hell!!」

stage0063_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$甲児$$
「What is this feeling...?
　Long ago, in some distant past,
　I feel like I fought like this before...」

stage0063_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is $$マジンガーＺ$$ trying to tell me something...?
　This feeling... connected to that golden god...?」

stage0063_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「$$兜甲児$$!
　I have long awaited this day!」

stage0063_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Ever since I lost Dr. Hell, I have lived
　only to take revenge on you all!
　Now, I fulfill that purpose!」

stage0063_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up, $$ブロッケン$$!
　Do you know how many people have suffered
　because of your selfish wish!」

stage0063_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$あしゅら$$!
　You listen too!」

stage0063_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll never forgive anyone who steals a person's peace!」

stage0063_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$甲児$$
「No matter how many times you come back,
　no matter how mighty a power you hold,
　$$マジンガーＺ$$ and I will crush your ambition!」

stage0063_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Playtime's over, $$弓さやか$$!
　Today, I'll fight you for real!」

stage0063_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$さやか$$
「Just what I wanted, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　I won't forgive what you've done!」

stage0063_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$さやか$$
「Watch closely!
　I'll hit you with a woman's pride and fury!」

stage0063_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ボス$$
「I'll settle this, you worn-out $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!」

stage0063_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I won't be told that by a junk robot like you!」

stage0063_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ボス$$
「We've both played it for laughs so far,
　but today, I'm going all out!」

stage0063_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Come, then!
　I have no intention of playing around either!」

stage0063_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ボス$$
「Then I won't hold back!
　I'm going all the way today!!」

stage0063_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We've cornered you, Mechanical Beast Army!
　I won't let you get away today!」

stage0063_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Naive, boy!
　You've been lured here, all of you!」

stage0063_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't lose to a threat like that!」

stage0063_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$!
　We'll knock that flying fortress down!」

stage0063_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You cut-rate robot from a tiny outfit!
　Your very existence is an eyesore!」

stage0063_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We wear rags, but our hearts are gold!
　I won't listen to a word from troublemakers
　like you lot!」

stage0063_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here we go, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　You won't be running away today!」

stage0063_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Looks like you're resolved, $$ブロッケン$$!
　I'll give you credit for that resolve!」

stage0063_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hmph...!
　I have no interest in an enemy's praise!」

stage0063_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「All I want to hear is your cry for mercy
　and your dying scream!」

stage0063_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So it's for real today, huh!?
　Bring it on!」

stage0063_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If that's the kind of guy I'm up against,
　I'll go full throttle too!!」

stage0063_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$葵$$
「Come to think of it, we go way back, don't we」

stage0063_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Sad to part with me, are you?
　You have a cute side after all」

stage0063_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「But what you should really mourn
　is your parting with this world!」

stage0063_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$葵$$
「You're good for a laugh to the end!
　If you think that death-defying resolve of
　yours can stop our wild side, think again!」

stage0063_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$葵$$
「Bye-bye, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　Take care of yourself in the next world!」

stage0063_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$タケル$$
「My psychic power is sensing it...!
　A premonition, that something huge is coming!」

stage0063_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Getting cold feet, $$明神タケル$$!?
　Well, it's no wonder!」

stage0063_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$タケル$$
「No...!
　This bad feeling isn't coming from you!」

stage0063_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$あしゅら男爵$$!
　I'll stop you right here!」

stage0063_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$タケル$$
「If I let you get away, I feel like something
　irreversible is going to happen!」

stage0063_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$赤木$$
「Out here, we don't have to worry about
　damage to the city, so we can go all out!」

stage0063_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Don't make me laugh, salaryman!
　Your best effort can't amount to much!」

stage0063_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's rich, coming from someone we've beaten before!」

stage0063_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$赤木$$
「Here we go, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　What salaryman spirit and guts can do,
　I'll show you plenty today!!」

stage0063_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hahaha, a spineless brat!
　I'll make you a moth flying into the flame!」

stage0063_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I won't lose to words like that!」

stage0063_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Wh- what!?
　This feels different from before!」

stage0063_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If you're going to settle this,
　I won't run away either!」

stage0063_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll do this too!
　To protect this world... everyone in it!」

stage0063_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$シモン$$
「Got some nerve, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　Fine, I'll face you head-on like you want!」

stage0063_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Then that prized drill of yours,
　I shall smash to bits!!」

stage0063_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$シモン$$
「If you think you can, then try it!」

stage0063_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Wh- what is this guy!?
　He's more fired up than ever before!」

stage0063_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$シモン$$
「I have someone waiting for me!
　Don't think you can break my bond with $$ニア$$!!」

stage0063_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Argh!
　No matter how huge an opponent is, there's
　always an opening! If I aim for it...!」

stage0063_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「If you think this $$ガンバスター$$ has
　something like that, you're dead wrong, girl!」

stage0063_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Here I come, evil Count!
　I'll crush your ambitions head-on!」

stage0063_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$n
「$$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　Our feud has gone on for quite a while!」

stage0063_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I won't let you say you've forgotten!
　Attacking Jindai High and taking us hostage!」

stage0063_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You're still holding a grudge over that!?」

stage0063_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$n
「That's rich, from you, out for revenge...!
　And while we're at it, let me say this:
　you're just holding a grudge for nothing!」

stage0063_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You...! Such a smart mouth!」

stage0063_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$n
「The anger of everyone whose peace you stole,
　I'll deliver it on their behalf!」
